certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Procurement and Strategic Sourcing

learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish tactical purchasing from strategic sourcing and category management
Analyse spend and segment a supply base to prioritise sourcing effort
Develop and execute a sourcing strategy including make-versus-buy decisions
Evaluate suppliers and run a structured tender and negotiation
Manage supplier risk, contracts and value over the relationship lifecycle

integrative_case: A procurement lead at a manufacturer must build a sourcing strategy for a high-spend packaging category: analyse the spend, segment suppliers, choose a sourcing approach, design the evaluation criteria, and justify the award and risk controls to the finance director.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
